members.cluster_pick_reason: #2215 makes the same buildWellKnownPath fix as #2214 (via a shared normalizeDiscoveryPath() helper) but additionally updates shouldAttemptFallback()'s root-path check from `pathname === '/'` to `pathname === ''` — a follow-on fix that #2214 does not make. Once trailing slashes are stripped with a full regex, a root pathname normalizes to '' instead of '/', so #2214 alone would leave shouldAttemptFallback's root check silently broken, causing a redundant extra fallback fetch for root-path discovery URLs. #2214 (tagged chore) does cover one extra call site (buildDiscoveryUrls) that isn't visible in #2215's diff excerpt, so that spot should be verified/ported over before closing #2214, but #2215 is the more complete correctness fix for the shared buildWellKnownPath logic and is titled as a `fix` with the regression it introduces already addressed.
